rows.en:
(There's a rumor going around that
a new planet has been found...)

(If that's true, our life here
will be coming to an end...)
Sigh...
rows.notes: Shared by the player, Yamashiro scene, Kagura (frd_kgr_112), Michel and Ranka (frd_rnk_005/008) and Hilda (nml_hld_008); 'Sigh...' fits all (Ranka's is followed by the player noticing her sigh).

rows.en:
What's wrong, \p?
You're making a strange face.

Wait, a strange face?
That's harsh!!
I'm joking.
That didn't sound like a joke at all...

That aside, what's wrong?
Is something bothering you?

It's not really bothering me, exactly.
I was just thinking how we'll be
reaching the new planet soon.

Once we reach the new planet,
a new life begins. The Academy isn't going
away, but our days will be different.

What will you do once we reach the new
planet, Sensei? Will you keep your
current job?

I don't know.
But there is something I'd like to try.

What about you?
Don't you have a dream for the future?
I've got things I'd like to try, too.
I do, but they're all kind of vague...
What do you want to do, Sensei?
I'm thinking of opening a museum.
A museum...

Nothing grand, of course.
Just something on the scale
of a private exhibition.
Wow, that's amazing.

If I could leave the wisdom and history
humanity has built up on the new planet,
in a form people can see...

Not that I was thinking anything like that
while I was collecting, mind you.

You should start sorting out your own
thoughts now, too. If I can be of help,
I'll gladly give you advice.
Yes, I'd really appreciate that!

There's no need to rush.
You're still young, after all.

(Something I'd like to try...
A dream, huh...)

(There's a rumor that
a new planet has been found...)

(If so, our life here will be over,
won't it...)

Hey, calling it a strange face
is so mean!!
That really didn't sound like a joke...

It's not really a worry, but...
I was just thinking we'll be reaching
the new planet soon.
I have things I'd like to try, too.
Wow~, that's amazing!
(The view from the roof is the best.)

You're not old enough to be brooding
at the sunset just yet.

S-Sensei!
When did you get here...!?

'When did you get here' is rude.
I was here before you were.
Seriously!?
I don't really have any worries, though...

Then tell me how things have been lately.
Talking to someone helps you
put information in order.

Sounds like you've been leading
a full life.
I can't really tell myself, though.

We'll reach the new planet before long.
Tackle everything with a positive attitude.
(A positive attitude, huh...)
(The view from the roof is just wonderful.)
Really!?

(We arrived at the new planet,
and a new life began.)

(Yamashiro-sensei made his dream come
true and opened a museum that's like
a little antique shop.)

(As for me, I'm still a student,
searching for my dream for the future.)

(Someday I want to make my dream come
true, just like Yamashiro-sensei.
I feel that more strongly every day.)
Yamashiro-sensei, what's up?
rows.notes: Ending scene; who came to whom is not shown. 'what's up?' stays neutral.

rows.en:
I've made my dream come true.
Now it's your turn.

Yes!
I'll be counting on your advice!

Yamashiro ending (male).
Slot filler for female.
rows.notes: Developer placeholder under Alto's name plate (female branch of the male-only ending frd_itk_009); translated literally, as c04107.
